data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a net deterioration in prior-year reserves totalling GBP 11.1m (deterioration/re-strengthening) relating to claims outstanding at the previous year end. The movement reflects a number of specific adverse developments on back years, notably increased notifications on New Zealand earthquake claims and adverse development on certain historic liability accounts (including UK Solicitors' PI) and an emergence of the Talisman claim. These prior-year pressures were partially offset by other favourable run-off elsewhere, but overall the prior-year movement was a modest strengthening of reserves.
